title: Viral Video Scout
description:
Turn Your Love of Viral Videos Into Income


Freelance Viral Video Scout (Remote – Global)


Company: Caters Media Group


Payment: Fixed fee per signed video


About Us

Caters Media Group is a leading international multimedia agency specialising in sourcing and licensing compelling video content to major global media outlets. We work with broadcasters, publishers and digital platforms around the world — and we’re always looking for the next viral moment before it hits the mainstream.

Many of our most successful scouts are people who already spend time discovering trending videos online. If you regularly spot viral moments before they explode across the internet, this could be an opportunity to turn that instinct into income.


The Opportunity

We are looking for motivated, self-driven individuals to join our global network of freelance Viral Video Scouts.

Your role will involve identifying compelling real-life videos online and helping us connect with the original creators so the content can be licensed to global media outlets.


Your responsibilities include:

Discover viral, newsworthy or emotionally compelling videos

Identify and verify the original creator of the content

Introduce creators to the opportunity to have their video licensed through Caters Media Group

Build rapport and, where required, speak with creators via phone or video call to explain how licensing works

Help secure signed agreements allowing Caters Media Group to represent the video

You earn a fixed fee for every video you successfully introduce that results in a signed licensing agreement.


No targets.

No fixed hours.

Work from anywhere.

Work when you want.


How It Works

You complete initial training with our team

We teach you what makes video content commercially valuable

We guide you on verifying ownership and introducing creators to the licensing opportunity

After training, you work independently identifying opportunities


You receive a fixed payment for each successfully signed video.


Your earnings depend on both the number of videos you secure and the quality and suitability of those submissions for licensing.


A fixed fee is paid once a creator has signed a licensing agreement with Caters Media Group for a video you introduced, and the video meets our internal quality and editorial guidelines.


All video submissions and creator agreements are subject to verification and approval by Caters Media Group before payment is issued.


This role is offered on an independent freelance basis and does not constitute employment with Caters Media Group.


What We’re Looking For

You don’t need formal qualifications — but you do need:

A sharp eye for viral and newsworthy video content

Confidence communicating with content creators

A strong standard of spoken and written English

The ability to speak with creators via phone or video call to explain licensing opportunities clearly and professionally

Self-motivation and initiative

Good time management


This role is ideal for people who:

Follow trending videos across multiple platforms daily

Enjoy spotting viral moments before they reach mainstream media

Understand the difference between original footage and reposted content

Enjoy identifying compelling real-life stories and moments

Are comfortable communicating with new people

Want flexible earning potential alongside other commitments

Are budding journalists interested in developing their news sense and editorial instincts

Work in journalism, media, or content creation and are looking to generate additional income alongside their existing work

If you regularly spot videos before they reach major news outlets, this role could be a strong fit.


  What This Is (And Isn’t)


✅ Flexible freelance opportunity 

✅ Fixed fee per signed video

✅ Work from anywhere

✅ Initial training provided

✅ No fixed hours

✅ No minimum targets

❌ Not a salaried role

❌ No guaranteed income

❌ Not suited to those uncomfortable speaking with creators directly


Important

Due to the high number of applications we receive, only candidates who follow the application instructions carefully and complete the example task will be considered.

Applications that do not meet the requirements below may not be reviewed.


Application Requirements

All applications must be submitted in English.

Please include the following:

Attach your CV / Resume in English

Tell us which social media platforms you use most frequently

Explain why you believe you would be good at identifying licensable video content

Example Video Task

Please provide one example of a recent viral video that you believe could generate licensing revenue.

The video must:

Be posted on the social media account of the original video owner (the person who filmed the content)

Have been posted within the last 24 hours

Include a direct link to the video

Along with the link, please include 2–3 sentences explaining why you believe the video has licensing potential.

Ownership Check - In one or two sentences, explain how you have determined that the person posting the video is the original owner of the footage.

To confirm you have read the full application instructions, please include the word “Scout” in the subject line of your application email.

title: Elementor Expert (WordPress Website Builder)
description:
We are looking for a skilled WordPress developer with strong Elementor experience to join our team and build high-performance websites for our marketing agency clients.


This role focuses on executing a proven build process , not designing sites from scratch. You’ll work from established Elementor Pro templates while inserting pre-generated content and images created by our internal AI systems.


If you enjoy working within clear systems and take pride in building clean, fast, and polished websites , this role will be a great fit.



Responsibilities


  • Build 3–4 WordPress websites per week using pre-built Elementor Pro templates
  • Insert AI-generated content into website layouts (all content is provided)
  • Adjust layouts and design elements to tailor each template for the client
  • Generate website visuals using AI image tools based on supplied prompts
  • Create simple design assets when needed using Canva
  • Integrate WooCommerce functionality for ecommerce websites
  • Ensure each website achieves extremely fast page load speeds (under 1 second)
  • Follow documented build processes and workflows precisely



Required Skills & Experience


  • Advanced proficiency with Elementor and Elementor Pro
  • Strong knowledge of WordPress performance optimization
  • Experience configuring WooCommerce within Elementor websites
  • Familiarity with AI image generation tools (Midjourney, DALL-E, OpenAI, etc.)
  • Basic graphic design ability and experience with Canva
  • Strong English communication skills
  • Available during EST business hours
  • Highly organized and comfortable working within defined processes



What This Role Focuses On


This role is about efficiently producing high-quality websites using a repeatable system .


You will not be responsible for writing content or designing full websites from scratch. Our automation tools generate the text and provide prompts for images. Your job is to assemble the site using templates, produce visuals, refine the layout, and ensure the final result is clean, professional, and extremely fast.



Important Note


⚡ Performance is critical.

Every site must achieve full page load speeds under 1 second without relying on caching solutions.


If you do not have strong experience optimizing WordPress for speed, this role will not be a good fit.



What We Provide


  • Managed hosting accounts
  • Elementor Pro licenses
  • AI-generated content for every site
  • Image prompts for generating visuals
  • Detailed documentation and build processes
  • A steady pipeline of website projects


Full-time role

Working hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (±1 hour flexibility)



Who We’re Looking For


The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, efficient, and process-driven . You take pride in producing polished work, enjoy following clear systems, and understand how small optimizations can dramatically impact website performance.


You’re comfortable using modern tools like AI image generators, you work quickly without sacrificing quality, and you care about delivering websites that are both visually clean and technically fast .

title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.


We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working from Brazil remotely to join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.


Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.


How You'll Help Us Connect the World:


You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.


Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.


Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.


Required Qualifications for Consideration:


  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.




Important Candidate Notice : On January 9, 2026, CommScope finalized the sale of its Connectivity and Cable Solutions segment, which included the CommScope name and brand, to Amphenol Corporation. The remaining businesses — Access Networks Solutions (now rebranded as Aurora Networks ) and RUCKUS Networks have been unified under the new parent company, renamed as Vistance Networks . The role being advertised is part of RUCKUS Networks.


Why Join Us?

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.


RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.


If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.


Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

description:
About SignalPET


SignalPET is a fast-growing veterinary AI company working alongside veterinarians and radiologists to deliver faster, more accurate diagnostic support. Our mission is to enhance clinical decision-making through intelligent technology grounded in real-world veterinary medicine.


We are expanding our Medical R&D team in Brazil and are looking for a clinically strong, detail-oriented veterinarian to help build and refine the medical intelligence powering our platform.


The Role


As a Veterinarian – Medical Education & Medical Content , you will transform real SignalPET clinical cases into structured educational modules and high-quality medical marketing content.


You will help build and execute the SignalPET Training Hub & Academy , including CE-accredited learning modules, case-based training, and medical campaigns that strengthen veterinarians’ radiology skills and reinforce SignalPET’s clinical authority.


This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role working closely with:


  • Board-certified radiologists
  • Medical R&D
  • AI and Product teams
  • Marketing


Key Responsibilities


Academy & CE Content Development


  • Develop structured, case-based learning modules using real SignalPET cases
  • Create CE-accredited courses, micro-learning sessions, pathology refreshers, and interactive quizzes
  • Build AI vs. Radiologist comparison educational insights
  • Work with specialists to validate medical accuracy
  • Manage and publish modules inside the Training Hub platform


Medical Marketing Content


  • Write clinically authoritative blogs, case spotlights, white papers, landing page content, and educational campaigns
  • Develop product-related medical materials and sales enablement tools
  • Collaborate with marketing to align messaging and positioning
  • Ensure scientific credibility through specialist validation


Workflow-Connected Learning


  • Map common clinical findings (e.g., splenic masses, thoracic disease, trauma cases) to relevant Academy modules
  • Collaborate with AI and Product teams to connect case workflows with learning opportunities


Performance & Optimization


  • Define and track CE engagement, learning participation, and content performance metrics
  • Continuously refine modules based on user feedback and clinical data


Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Participate in relevant internal meetings
  • Provide medical clarification for marketing and product initiatives
  • Coordinate with specialists and Medical R&D for content validation


Requirements


  • Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) or equivalent
  • Clinical Experience - Hands-on experience in small animal practice
  • Strong radiographic interpretation skills (canine & feline)
  • Radiology-focused experience is a plus
  • Excellent English writing skills (medical & educational content)
  • Ability to translate complex medical topics into clear, structured content
  • Experience creating CE-accredited content is a strong advantage
  • Strong small animal radiology knowledge
  • Ability to collaborate with board-certified specialists
  • Understanding of adult learning principles
  • Comfortable working in CMS and digital platforms


Working Hours


  • Monday to Friday - 7am to 4pm

Please ensure that you check your messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.

title: Pessoa engenheira de gestão de ativos

Presente em 30 países e com 98 mil colaboradores, o Grupo atua em toda a cadeia de valor da energia, da geração renovável e gás verde à infraestrutura e fornecimento.
No Brasil, a ENGIE , empresa líder em energia 100% renovável do país, atua em geração, comercialização e transmissão de energia elétrica, Operação, manutenção e transporte de gás , e soluções energéticas. A empresa possui cerca de 13 GW de capacidade instalada, provenientes de fontes renováveis e com baixas emissões de Gases de Efeito Estufa (GEE), como usinas hidrelétricas, eólicas, solares e a biomassa.
A ENGIE Serviços de Operação e Manutenção é responsável por operar e manter os gasodutos da TAG, empresa adquirida pelo grupo em 2020. Com a aquisição da TAG , a ENGIE é detentora da mais extensa malha de transporte de gás natural do país com 4.500 km que atravessam 10 estados e 191 municípios.

e sustentável.

técnicos, e garantindo o cumprimento das normas aplicáveis

title: Analista de sistemas pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga
A NETRA está em busca de talentos para fazer parte de uma jornada de transformação digital. Acreditamos no ser humano como peça fundamental nessa caminhada e você pode fazer parte dessa trajetória.
Faça parte da mudança!
Buscamos por um Analista de Sistemas Pleno para atuar em Salvador-BA.
Responsabilidades e atribuições Diariamente esse profissional vai:
Desenvolver aplicações utilizando linguagens como PHP, Java, Java Script, Python, Type Script, Kotlin , além de tecnologias React, React Native, Android, HTML e CSS , entre outras linguagens de alto nível com interface gráfica. Utilizar os principais frameworks associados às linguagens mencionadas. Realização de modelagem, implementação e manutenção de bancos de dados Microsoft SQL Server, My SQL e Postgre SQL , em ambientes cliente/servidor e web. Atuar com foco em UI/UX , contribuindo na definição e melhoria da experiência e interface do usuário. Utilizar de forma avançada o Git Lab para versionamento, controle de código e gestão de branches. Participar de reuniões operacionais e acompanhamento do plano de trabalho, exercendo controle sobre prazos e entregas, bem como notificando coordenadores sobre riscos ou possíveis problemas futuros.
Realizar análises técnicas e programação sempre que necessário ou previsto no plano de trabalho.
Conduzir treinamentos e elaborar manuais para implantação das soluções desenvolvidas.
Atuar com metodologias ágeis , colaborando em rituais e práticas voltadas à melhoria contínua dos processos. Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento e gestão de projetos para organização, acompanhamento e entrega das demandas.
Desenvolver aplicativos móveis para Android e i OS .
Requisitos e qualificações
Se ligue que você precisa de:
Ensino superior completo.
Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de sistemas web e mobile.
Domínio das linguagens e frameworks mencionados.
Conhecimento sólido em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, My SQL e Postgre SQL).
Certificação SFC (Scrum Fundaments Certified).
Conhecimento avançado em versionamento com Git Lab . Experiência com ferramentas de desenvolvimento e gestão de projetos.
Mas vai ser ótimo : conhecer plataformas digitais de design de interface do usuário (UI) e experiência do usuário (UX).
Benefícios
Total Pass;
Benefício refeição/alimentação (i Food);
Assistência médica;
Assistência psicológica;
Assistência odontológica;
Parcerias com instituições de ensino (escolas e universidades), restaurantes, entre outros;
Oportunidade de crescimento profissional.
Na Netra, acreditamos que a tecnologia só faz sentido quando aproxima pessoas, impulsiona negócios e promove mudanças reais na sociedade. Há 25 anos, desenvolvemos soluções digitais sob medida para os desafios do setor público e privado, sempre com o compromisso de inovar com propósito.
Fazemos parte de um ecossistema de parceiros globais e contamos com uma equipe multidisciplinar que combina experiência, criatividade e visão de futuro. Aqui, valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado contínuo e a diversidade como forças que nos ajudam a ir além.
Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, onde suas ideias têm espaço para crescer e gerar impacto, a Netra é o lugar certo. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

description:
What a day in the life looks like:
Provide frontline support via phone and ticketing systems to resolve software-related issues.

Experience with labeling software (e.g., Bartender) and voice solutions such as Honeywell is a plus.
Familiarity with Service Now or other industry-standard ticketing systems is preferred.
Fluency in English. MandatoryYou Are Skilled With And Have Significant Experience WithSupply chain and distribution industry knowledge and experience.
Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) expertise in Red Prairie (JDA), Manhattan Associates, SAP- WM, Oracle-WM, Accellos, Infor, etc.
Barcode scanning and RF hardware (Intermec, LXE, Motorola, Symbol)
Labeling (Bartender or Loftware) experience a plus
Reporting (Cognos, Business Objects, SSRS) experience a plus
Networking (Cisco, WAN/LAN, troubleshooting)Why join us?
At Infios, we're not just looking for employees; we're looking for partners in innovation, growth, and purpose. Meeting you where you are to create the future you need is at the core of who we are and what we do. Whether you're at the beginning of your career or a seasoned expert, we meet you on your journey, equipping you with the tools and opportunities to build the future you envision. Together, we will relentlessly work toward one common goal - making supply chains better.

title: Bilingual civil engineer (load analysis: structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems)
description:
The Company
Datamtx ( / formerly Datamatics) established in 1993 and globally HQ'd in Atlanta has a stellar history supporting both Tier 1 and 2 Manufacturing ERP rollouts ranging from implementations, data cleanse, migrations, customization, hypercare and Day 1 support. We are also nationally aligned with leading accounting firms & VARs.
Our ERP / CRM coverage includes: SAP, Oracle EBS/Fusion, Oracle Cloud ERP, Peoplesoft, JDE, Infor (M3, LX, XA, LN, System 21), IFS, Epicor, Sys Pro, D365 & Salesforce.
One of our longest standing service verticals has been assisting transition clients from legacy systems to cloud based platforms including introduction of Cloud / Gen AI and MS-Fabric, RAG models.We are seeking a multipleCivil Engineerswith emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.
English language proficiency is mandatory.These are remote roles.This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.ROLES:
1) Civil Engineers(3+ years of experience)
2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE(0-3 years of experience)Executive Summary
Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.Primary Duties
Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.
Quality & Accountability: Staff must maintain a 95% quality score ; consistent failure to meet these standards requires a Performance Improvement Plan within 10 business days.Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering
Professional accreditation or licensure in their home country (preferred but not mandatory)
Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leadsExperience level
Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field

title: Coordenador de arquitetura de dados
description:
Sobre a área:A área de Arquitetura de Dados é responsável por definir, estruturar e sustentar as bases tecnológicas que permitem a coleta, o processamento, a integração e o consumo de dados de forma segura, escalável e alinhada às estratégias do negócio. Atua na definição de padrões, políticas e modelos arquiteturais, garantindo a qualidade, governança e disponibilidade das informações para apoiar análises, produtos de dados e a tomada de decisão em toda a organização.Além do aspecto técnico, a área trabalha de forma colaborativa com times de TI, Analytics e áreas de negócio, antecipando necessidades, avaliando tecnologias emergentes e propondo soluções inovadoras. Seu papel é viabilizar uma arquitetura robusta e sustentável, que suporte o crescimento da empresa, promova eficiência operacional e fortaleça a cultura orientada a dados.Principais atividades:Coordenar atividades operacionais do time de Arquitetura e Plataforma de Dados.
Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de arquiteturas de dados alinhadas aos objetivos
organizacionais.
Participação em processos de recrutamento e desenvolvimento de talentos e desligamento de
profissionais.
Fomentar o desenvolvimento técnico da equipe, promovendo um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo
e desenvolvimento de habilidades.
Interagir com líderes de outras áreas para entender suas necessidades analíticas.

Relatar os resultados para a gerência e recomendar melhorias.
Tomar decisões relacionadas à arquitetura de dados

Definir estratégias de Gestão e moldar a direção técnica.
Resolver desafios complexos e inovadores.
Estabelecer parcerias estratégicas.
Fomentar a disseminação de uma cultura organizacional que valorize a utilização eficaz de dados na
tomada de decisões.
Acompanhamento de tendências em engenharia de dados e aplicação de tecnologias emergentes

do setor

horas
Verificação e orientação sobre atestados médicos e licenças e participação em iniciativas de saúde e
suporte ao bem-estar
Contribuição para políticas de remuneração, benefícios, reconhecimento, incentivos, feedback e
mentorias
Participação no desenvolvimento de planos de carreira, treinamento e desenvolvimento individual

Engenharia ou área correlata.
Inglês intermediário (desejável avançado para leitura)
Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Jira, Project)

Experiência em liderança para recrutar, delegar e motivar um time de profissionais de dados.
Experiência em desenvolvimento de talentos e gestão de desempenho.
Experiência em gestão de orçamento para alocar recursos de maneira eficiente.
Visão estratégica de negócios e do time de dados.
Experiência em gestão de projetos de dadosConhecimentos Técnicos:Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C): Expertise em ferramentas de Ia C como Terraform, Pulumi e
Cloud Formation.
Plataformas de Dados: Expertise em Databricks, incluindo gerenciamento e otimização de clusters.
Computação em Nuvem: Experiência avançada com AWS, incluindo serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda,
RDS, EMR, Glue, Athena e Sage Maker. Conhecimento em GCP e Azure é um diferencial.
Ferramentas de CDC: Conhecimento e uso de ferramentas de CDC, entendo os tradeoffs entre as
diferentes ferramentas e quando faz sentido usar cada.
Armazenamento e Arquitetura de Dados: Conhecimento profundo em arquiteturas de data
lakehouse, incluindo Delta Lake e a estrutura Medallion.
Deploy de Modelos de Machine Learning: Experiência avançada no deploy e monitoramento de
modelos de machine learning.
Ferramentas de ETL e Orquestração: Expertise com Apache Airflow, dbt, e outras ferramentas de ETL.
Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência avançada em Python e SQL.
Boas Práticas de Engenharia de Software: Aplicação de princípios de engenharia de software, como
controle de versão, testes automatizados, integração contínua e deploy contínuo (CI/CD).
Governança de Dados: Expertise em políticas de governança de dados, incluindo a gestão de dados
sensíveis e privados, conformidade com regulamentos (ex: LGPD), e uso de catálogos de dados para
garantir a acessibilidade e qualidade dos dados.Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

title: Graphic designer
description:
Company DescriptionEMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now Saa S products.
We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.
We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.You AreAn experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.
You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and Saa S-oriented design work.Role Description This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.
You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing Saa S initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.
Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.
Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.ResponsibilitiesDesign graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
Support video and social content with strong visual design
Contribute to UX/UI design for Saa S and internal software products
Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without frictionQualificationsStrong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
Attention to detail and strong design judgment
Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
Fluent in English, written and spoken

description:
Requisitos:
Ensino superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis Economia ou áreas correlatas;
Disponibilidade para atuar de forma presencial em Feira de Santana-BA;
Experiência na área;
Conhecimento das técnicas de negociação, conhecimento do mercado de fornecimento, conhecimento em formação de preços de serviços (ex. despesas com pessoal, encargos, impostos, margens) e em Strategic Sourcing;
Noções em análise de contratos e em análise de risco de fornecimento ( ex.: financeiro, logística, prazos, obrigações acessórias)
Vivência em Pacote Office;
Conhecimento em Sistema Integrado (ERP), ex.: SAP;
Desejável Inglês Intermediário.
Atividades:
Atuar nos processos de compras que podem apresentar algum nível de complexidade em relação a estratégia de compras, negociação, riscos de fornecimento, volume e preços.
Analisar os pedidos de compra, identificando e recomendando soluções de fornecimento em relação às necessidades apresentadas e estabelecer a estratégia de compras conforme os objetivos do negócio.
Estruturar as cotações, analisar e conduzir o processo de negociação junto aos fornecedores considerando a melhor condição comercial possível.
Recomendar o fornecedor para fechamento da aquisição e disponibilizar o pedido de compra no sistema para aprovação dos envolvidos na cadeia de suprimentos.
Estabelecer, com base em histórico e perfil dos itens a serem comprados, contratos de fornecimento, interagindo com o jurídico e fornecedores para elaboração, negociação e fechamentos dos contratos.
Participar e suportar o processo de análise crítica de itens de compras que apresentam maior risco para aquisição (ex. variações de preço, consumo, logística de fornecimento) e recomendar ações para mitigação de riscos.
Atuar no desenvolvimento comercial de novos fornecedores.
Realizar as atividades da sua função conforme as normas técnicas, procedimentos da qualidade, limpeza, organização, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente.
Realizar análise de indicadores e matérias primas para avaliação de preços.
Apresentar relatórios que corrobore para explicação de variações do Budget.
Conduzir negociações em sinergia com outras unidades da Bracell (nacional e internacional).
Realizar outras atividades correlatas às descritas acima, compatível com a sua condição pessoal e conforme solicitado pelo seu superior imediato.

title: Senior mainframe automation engineer
description:
Descrição da Vaga:
“Estamos buscando umEngenheiro Sênior de Automação de Mainframeexperiente para liderar a migração e otimização de soluções de automação em mainframe. Esta função tem como foco a transição doCA OPS/MVSpara oIBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OSe doCA Automation Pointpara oIBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM).
O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.
Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação.”Principais Responsabilidades:
Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.
Configurar e implementar soluções IBM Systems Automation, incluindo automação baseada em políticas para ambientes z/OS.
Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações doSystem Automation Policy Database (PDB).
Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?
Experiência em Operações de Mainframe:Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS:Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
CA OPS/MVS:Avançado.
TSO e ISPF:Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
JCL:Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
Programação REXX:Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
System Automation Policy Database (PDB):Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
Experiência em Migração:Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
Net View for z/OS:Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
Scripting REXX:Avançado.Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?
Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
Experiência comSMP/Epara instalação e manutenção de software.
Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

title: Senior software developer (react.js / node.js)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-timeSenior Software Developerwith 5+ years of software development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js to join our U. S. client's engineering team. You will lead, develop and enhance Saa S products used by thousands of customers. The right candidate is self-driven with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle who wants to make an impact on technology that reaches customers and consumers globally.
The ideal candidate has strong experience working with technical onshore, offshore, and nearshore teams along with modern cloud-based platforms particularly within the AWS, Salesforce, Linode, and Heroku ecosystem, and is comfortable leading and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to support data-driven decision-making.
Our client provides innovative software solutions for automobile retailers having lead the market since 2014. With over 6,000 customers across North America, the company enhances the buying experience with cutting-edge software that eases communication and converts interest into purchases. Backed by private equity, the company's software features span website conversion, sales enablement, service offers management, retention marketing, and communication through the lenses of valuations, payments, inventory merchandising, and video.Responsibilities
Lead the design, development, and maintenance of complex web applications using Type Script, React.js, and Node.js, ensuring high-quality code standards and architectural best practices
Mentor junior developers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable software solutions
Drive technical decision-making for system architecture, technology stack choices, and development processes while maintaining comprehensive documentation and testing strategies
Follow agile software development processes, collaborating with both onshore and offshore teams
Contribute to the development of cloud-based software using Node.js, React.js, Type Script, Salesforce APEX and Lightning, Postgre SQL, AWS, Mongo DB,. NET, PHP, Ro R, Python, ETL/Data feeds, and Heroku
Continuously learn and adopt new technologies to improve product functionalityRequired Experience
Excellent English communications skills
5-10+ years of professional software development experience
Experience with expertise in Type Script, React, Node.js, and modern Java Script frameworks and libraries
Experience in Salesforce Lightning and SLDS, APEX, Batch, External Client Apps (Connected App), Remote setting, Salesforce Revenue Cloud with legacy applications and Net Suite
Experience in Business intelligence Quick Sight developers, ETL process, and data extraction

Experience in leading software product development projects

Working under limited supervision and developing code for new business features based on functional and technical specs

Works with product management to groom and select Features for their area to be included in upcoming releases
Comfortable working within a fast-paced environment
Self-starter and resourceful
Ability to work independently or as part of a team
Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparentDesired Experience

title: Médico endocrinologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"
Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas emEndocrinologia!Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade emEndocrinologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:Fornecer atendimento médico especializado emEndocrinologiade forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbiosEndocrinológicos.Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade emEndocrinologiae critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doençasEndocrinológicas.Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde emEndocrinologia.Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento title: Senior azure cloud architect
description:
About You
You are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, Dev Ops, security, and infrastructure teams.You thrive in complex enterprise environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and act as a technical reference for Azure architecture, networking, security, and platform automation.You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
Proven experience implementing Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Landing Zones.
Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management.
Experience designing enterprise Azure architectures, including multi-subscription environments.
Strong experience with Azure Dev Ops, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance.
Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity.
Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise-scale architecture.
Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards.
Strong problem-solving skills and clear technical communication.
Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-104, AZ-204) and/or Terraform certification (nice to have).
Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Design and implement Azure tenant architectures aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Landing Zone best practices.
Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation.
Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging.
Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines.
Design and maintain multi-stage Azure Dev Ops pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation.
Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity.
Support containerized platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls.
Collaborate with application, Dev Ops, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption.
Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.
Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.Qualifications
5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures
Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
Experience with Azure Dev Ops and CI/CD pipelines (YAML)
Advanced English proficiency.Additional Information
About UsAtApplaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with anAI-native mindsetat the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values:Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication.These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

title: Senior data engineer
description:
Hello from RE Partners!Who We Are:We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.
The 3 G’s of RE:
“Get Shit Done.”
“Get Over Shit.”
“Give a Shit.”This role exists to drive value for our customers and business functions through effective data engineering, modelling, and data transformations by leading the delivery of strategic data solutions whilst setting up resilient data architecture and engineering foundations and supporting junior members of the data engineering team.Responsible for:
Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.
Building in quality by design into data engineering practices, enabling a scalable and flexible data architecture and feature rich dataset to support the wider Data function and the entire business.
Implementing modern code development and data engineering orchestration strategies to target and streamline our data engineering processes.
Embedding new data techniques into the business through coaching, training, and providing experiment design oversight to more junior data engineers.
Working with third party partners and software providers to improve and/or implement new data solutions and processes.
Being the gatekeeper for customer data, aware of our usage and alignment to data privacy standards, in collaboration with Data Governance to ensure best practice standards are applied/maintained.Accountable for:
Working closely with our Lead Data and ML Engineers to drive the adoption of Dev Ops and modern code development practices across the Data function.
Collaborating with Quality and Software Engineering and System teams to drive cross-function visibility and reduction of technical debt across the teams.
Ensuring that our data engineering processes and pipelines are resilient and future-proof.
Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users/processors across the company.
Being a Senior Data Engineer, supporting more junior data engineering colleagues from a technical skills development perspective.Essential skills and experience:
Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.
GCP experience, including Dataproc and Dataflow
Hands on Java experience
Hands on experience in modern code development practices (Infrastructure-as-Code) and data engineering in the Google Cloud
Experience of ETL/ELT technical design, automated testing of engineering pipelines, quality assurance and documentation.
Proven experience of data warehousing, data wrangling and data modelling approaches.
Proven experience coaching junior members of data engineering teams and supporting their skills development.
Proven experience working collaboratively with System, Quality Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
Demonstrable experience of critical thinking, communication and problem-solving ability and stakeholder management
Demonstrate delivery under pressure and to deadline.
Experience working in an e-commerce/retail market would be beneficial.Preferred skills and experience:
Willingness to learn new tools and techniques; proactively keeping up to date with latest thinking and practices.
Able to establish what does/doesn’t align to business/functional strategies/priorities and communicate dependencies clearly.
Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.
Embrace change with a positive outlook.
Confident to challenge, and receptive to being challenged.
The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.Join Our Global Team:We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonusEqual Opportunity Employer:

Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub.Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!About the opportunity
As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.
﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew.We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?Key Responsibilities:Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
Customer Support
Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
Documentation & Reporting
Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
Escalation Management
Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.Skills & Qualifications:Technical Expertise:
Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, mac OS, Linux) and common software applications.
Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
Problem-solving Ability:
An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
Communication Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
Organizational Skills:
Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.Preferred Experience:Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, i OS).
Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
Previous work with an American company
Education & Certifications:Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern Saa S platforms.Who You Are:
A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
Passion for helping others internally and externally
Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
In addition, we give bonus points for having a Saa S or Ecommerce background!

title: Key account manager
description:
NOTA:
Queremos ser muito sinceros: devido ao nível de desafio, sabemos que trabalhar na Wareclouds não é para todos. Se você é uma pessoa que busca se desafiar ao máximo, resolver problemas difíceis e trabalhar no ritmo de um time de alto desempenho, este lugar é para você.A única forma de se sentir confortável em um ambiente de alto desempenho é que isso seja exatamente o que você está procurando. Caso contrário, nossa cultura pode não ser a ideal para vocêAcerca a Wareclouds
Olhe ao seu redor por um momento. Grande parte do que você vê foi impactado por dados, processos e algoritmos. No entanto, muitas operações ainda se baseiam em métodos tradicionais e não aproveitam ao máximo as capacidades tecnológicas atuais. Na Wareclouds, estamos desafiando esse modelo.Imagine um mundo em que as operações logísticas acontecem de forma fluida, sem atritos e com precisão milimétrica, apoiadas por análises de dados robustas e automações inteligentes. Na Wareclouds, tornamos isso realidade, utilizando tecnologias avançadas para otimizar operações logísticas e apoiar a tomada de decisões.Não estamos apenas transformando a forma como as empresas operam, também estamos construindo um futuro mais eficiente e orientado por dados. Se você quer fazer parte dessa transformação, junte-se a nós!Juntos, estamos redefinindo como as empresas operam e tomam decisões baseadas em dados!O que estamos procurando?
Dado o crescimento acelerado da Wareclouds no Brasil e a necessidade de maior eficiência na gestão de clientes enterprise, estamos em busca do/a nosso/a próximo/a Key Account Manager (KAM) Estratégico, que será responsável pela gestão, expansão e retenção de grandes contas, atuando como dono(a) da estratégia e do relacionamento de longo prazo.Essa pessoa terá um papel central na estruturação e crescimento das operações, na expansão geográfica, na governança estratégica das contas e na garantia de que os clientes enterprise cresçam de forma sustentável, alinhados aos objetivos de longo prazo da Wareclouds.Quais seriam suas responsabilidades?
Atuar como principal ponto focal de grandes contas, garantindo relacionamento estratégico e de longo prazo
Liderar a estratégia de crescimento das contas enterprise, com foco em expansão de volume, regiões e operações
Coordenar operações distribuídas em múltiplos Centros de Distribuição, garantindo padronização, eficiência e qualidade
Planejar e acompanhar a abertura de novas operações e centros, em parceria com os times de Operações, Produto e Tecnologia
Conduzir rituais de governança (follow-ups estratégicos, análises de performance, QBRs e planos de ação)
Atuar fortemente em retenção, antecipando riscos e oportunidades de crescimento
Traduzir necessidades dos clientes em demandas claras para os times internos
Garantir alinhamento entre estratégia, operação e execução no dia a dia
Tomar decisões baseadas em dados e indicadores de performanceO que esperamos de você?
Formação superior em Administração, Comunicação, Economia, Logística ou áreas correlatas
Experiência prévia como Key Account, Account Manager ou função similar, gerenciando grandes contas
Vivência com múltiplos stakeholders e ambientes corporativos complexos
Forte capacidade de pensamento estratégico aliado à execução
Perfil analítico, orientado a dados e métricas
Excelente comunicação, negociação e relacionamento
Alta autonomia, senso de dono(a) e capacidade de priorização
Conforto em ambientes de ritmo acelerado e alta performanceDesejável
Experiência em logística, supply chain, e-commerce ou operações complexas
Vivência com contas enterprise ou multinacionais
Experiência com operações distribuídas / descentralizadas
Espanhol para comunicação com times internos

title: Business development representative mid
description:
About the company:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.
Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.About the Opportunity:
Avenue Code is expanding US Business Development team and looking for a highly proactive, organized, and fluent English speaker to join as a BDR. This person will be responsible for generating qualified leads and supporting the sales team with prospecting across different business lines, including AI, cloud, staffing, and internal products.
You'll work with modern tools and automations, including AI-powered content creation to assist in outreach. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow and have a direct impact on pipeline development.Responsibilities:
Lead prospecting in the US market focused on setting qualified meetings.
Use tools like Apollo, Linked In, and pre-built cadences to reach out to prospects.
Make cold calls when necessary.
Keep interactions and activities updated in Salesforce.
Manage multiple campaigns simultaneously across many business areas (AI, cloud, staffing, etc.).
Partner closely with Account Executives.Requirements
Fluent English (spoken and written).
Previous experience as a BDR or SDR.
Highly organized and able to follow structured processes.
Comfortable using prospecting and automation tools (e.g., Apollo, Linked In Sales Navigator).
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Proactive, results-driven, and motivated by performance.Nice to Have
Experience selling technology solutions (e.g., Google Cloud, AI, Salesforce).
Background in consulting or IT services companies.
Familiarity with Salesforce as a CRM.

title: Java fullstack developer (angular)
description:
About You
You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
6+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
Hands-on experience with Postgre SQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, Cloud Watch, and Bedrock.
Experience using My Batis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of Rx JS and Observables.
Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using Rx JS and Observables.
Implement and manage data persistence using Postgre SQL, My Batis, Liquibase, and Redis.
Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, Cloud Watch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.Qualifications
Hands-on experience with: Java 21, Spring Boot, Postgre SQL, Redis, Monolithic architecture design and development, AWS (S3, ECS, Cloud Watch), Angular (v19 or similar), Rx JS / Observables, My Batis and Liquibase.
Strong communication skills in English and Spanish.Additional Information
About UsAtApplaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with anAI-native mindsetat the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values:Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication.These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

title: Senior ai/ml developer
description:
About The Opportunity
We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Developer to lead the technical development of an Industrial RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solution for a major US-based client. The project addresses a critical challenge: transitioning 25 years of historical lab reports from Share Point into an intelligent, Gen AI-powered knowledge retrieval system.
You will be responsible for building a two-phase solution, starting with a Proof of Concept (POC) for a Pricing Analyst Agent and evolving into a Production-Ready Conversational AI Agent. This role focuses on automating knowledge retrieval, preserving institutional expertise, and enhancing the accuracy of fluid design processes through scalable AWS architectures.Responsibilities
Develop and validate robust AI architectures leveraging AWS Infrastructure, specifically Amazon Bedrock and Sage Maker.
Create Gen AI pipelines and multi-agent workflows using AWS Step Functions, Lambda, and Event Bridge.
Design platforms for processing massive volumes of unstructured data (text, image, audio, and video) integrated with RAG patterns.
Build interactive front-ends and AI dashboards using Streamlit for demos and operational workflows.
Implement best practices for AI governance, security, and observability using AWS IAM and Cloud Watch.
Fine-tune pricing normalization and data retrieval to reduce bid risk and improve decision accuracy.Required Qualifications
Good English communication skills (mandatory for direct collaboration with US stakeholders).

title: Key account manager
description:
NOTA:
Queremos ser muito sinceros: devido ao nível de desafio, sabemos que trabalhar na Wareclouds não é para todos. Se você é uma pessoa que busca se desafiar ao máximo, resolver problemas difíceis e trabalhar no ritmo de um time de alto desempenho, este lugar é para você.A única forma de se sentir confortável em um ambiente de alto desempenho é que isso seja exatamente o que você está procurando. Caso contrário, nossa cultura pode não ser a ideal para vocêAcerca a Wareclouds
Olhe ao seu redor por um momento. Grande parte do que você vê foi impactado por dados, processos e algoritmos. No entanto, muitas operações ainda se baseiam em métodos tradicionais e não aproveitam ao máximo as capacidades tecnológicas atuais. Na Wareclouds, estamos desafiando esse modelo.Imagine um mundo em que as operações logísticas acontecem de forma fluida, sem atritos e com precisão milimétrica, apoiadas por análises de dados robustas e automações inteligentes. Na Wareclouds, tornamos isso realidade, utilizando tecnologias avançadas para otimizar operações logísticas e apoiar a tomada de decisões.Não estamos apenas transformando a forma como as empresas operam, também estamos construindo um futuro mais eficiente e orientado por dados. Se você quer fazer parte dessa transformação, junte-se a nós!Juntos, estamos redefinindo como as empresas operam e tomam decisões baseadas em dados!O que estamos procurando?
Dado o crescimento acelerado da Wareclouds no Brasil e a necessidade de maior eficiência na gestão de clientes enterprise, estamos em busca do/a nosso/a próximo/a Key Account Manager (KAM) Estratégico, que será responsável pela gestão, expansão e retenção de grandes contas, atuando como dono(a) da estratégia e do relacionamento de longo prazo.Essa pessoa terá um papel central na estruturação e crescimento das operações, na expansão geográfica, na governança estratégica das contas e na garantia de que os clientes enterprise cresçam de forma sustentável, alinhados aos objetivos de longo prazo da Wareclouds.Quais seriam suas responsabilidades?
Atuar como principal ponto focal de grandes contas, garantindo relacionamento estratégico e de longo prazo
Liderar a estratégia de crescimento das contas enterprise, com foco em expansão de volume, regiões e operações

Atuar fortemente em retenção, antecipando riscos e oportunidades de crescimento
Traduzir necessidades dos clientes em demandas claras para os times internos
Garantir alinhamento entre estratégia, operação e execução no dia a dia

Formação superior em Administração, Comunicação, Economia, Logística ou áreas correlatas
Experiência prévia como Key Account, Account Manager ou função similar, gerenciando grandes contas

Alta autonomia, senso de dono(a) e capacidade de priorização

title: Compliance officer
description:
Compliance OfficerTG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such asStake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players. Our i Gaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across theEU, USA , andAsia.We are looking for a meticulous and proactive Compliance Officer to ensure our operations and business activities adhere to all legal, technical and regulatory requirements, as well as internal policies. As a key member of the compliance team, you will work across departments to promote a strong compliance culture and help safeguard the company’s integrity and reputation.Responsibilities:Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant regulatory authorities (MGA, Mincetur, SPA, AGCO etc.)
Ensure compliance with relevant frameworks (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS).
Conduct regular audits and technical assessments to evaluate risk and compliance.
Develop and maintain compliance documentation, including security policies, data handling procedures, and audit reports.
Assist Chief Compliance officer to launch the new project in existing or new markets.
Stay up to date with changes in laws and regulations affecting data privacy,various regulatory frameworks, cybersecurity, and industry standards.
Provide guidance and training to staff on compliance-related matters.
Manage third-party vendor compliance assessments and onboarding processes.
Coordinate internal and external audits; respond to audit findings and implement corrective actions.
Assist in incident response investigations and ensure post-incident compliance actions are executed.Requirements:2-4 years of experience in compliance or risk/aml management (IT security would be a plus).
Previous experience in compliance, data protection laws and cyber security.
Exceptional documentation and analytical skills.Working with us implies:
﻿
Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills.We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

title: Investment banking intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program
Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.We are activelyscreening thousands of top students globallyto identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered inpartnership with leading boutique investment banksin key markets, includingthe US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.Only two students are selected per quarterfor this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.What You'll Gain:
Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2):The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
3-Statement Financial Modeling
Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
Trading Comparables (Comps)
Precedent Transactions
Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques
Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10):Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
Pitch Book Development
Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
Financial Modeling
Sourcing & Due Diligence
Industry and Company Research
And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
Mentorship & Feedback:Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.Who We're Looking For:
This program is ideal for highly motivated1st year and 2nd year students(not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who arehungry, quick learners, and committedto excelling in a fast-paced environment.How to Apply:
Get your application in now!
